functions.name: nosax
functions.desc: computes the product of (1 if there are none) the squares of the even digits of n

functions.name: lupal
functions.desc: computes the sum of one plus each of the odd digits of n

functions.name: zekax
functions.desc: computes the largest of (0 if there are none) the squares of the digits that occur exactly once in n
impls:
def zekax(n):
    import math
    digits = [int(c) for c in str(abs(n))]
    selected = [x for x in digits if digits.count(x) == 1]
    v = []
    for x in selected:
        v.append(x * x)
    return max(v) if v else 0

def zekax(n):
    import math
    digits = list(map(int, str(abs(n))))
    v = [x * x for x in [x for x in digits if digits.count(x) == 1]]
    return max(v) if v else 0

functions.name: zusoth

functions.name: lufemun
functions.desc: computes the largest minus the smallest of (0 if there are none) the digits that occur exactly once in n
impls:
def lufemun(n):
    import math
    digits = [int(c) for c in str(abs(n))]
    selected = [x for x in digits if digits.count(x) == 1]
    v = []
    for x in selected:
        v.append(x)
    return (max(v) - min(v)) if v else 0

def lufemun(n):
    import math
    digits = list(map(int, str(abs(n))))
    v = [x for x in [x for x in digits if digits.count(x) == 1]]
    return (max(v) - min(v)) if v else 0

functions.name: fekin
functions.desc: computes the largest of (0 if there are none) the squares of the digits of n at odd positions counting from the right (last digit is position 0)
impls:
def fekin(n):
    import math
    digits = [int(c) for c in str(abs(n))]
    selected = [x for i, x in enumerate(reversed(digits)) if i % 2 == 1]
    v = []
    for x in selected:
        v.append(x * x)
    return max(v) if v else 0

def fekin(n):
    import math
    digits = list(map(int, str(abs(n))))
    v = [x * x for x in [x for i, x in enumerate(digits[::-1]) if i % 2 == 1]]
    return max(v) if v else 0
